name: Shimmering Salt Flats
description: Vast, perfectly flat plains of reflective white salt punctuated by low-poly crystal clusters.

name: Luminescent Wetlands
description: Shallow, murky marshlands featuring glowing lilies and gentle hummocks of damp moss.

name: Whispering Meadows
description: Softly rolling low hills covered in golden grass that sways under calm winds.

name: Petrified Woodlands
description: Mildly undulating terrain dotted with ancient stone tree stumps and mossy boulders.

name: Emberwood Steppe
description: Broad savannah plateaus carved by shallow basalt step-terraces and smoldering brush.

name: Crystal Dunes
description: Sweeping sand dunes anchored by medium-height quartz formations refracting ambient light.

name: Sunken Fungal Basin
description: A deep terraced basin overgrown with towering cap mushrooms and bioluminescent spores.

name: Frostspire Taiga
description: Rugged alpine slopes densely packed with pine trees and intersected by icy ravines.

name: Obsidian Highlands
description: Jagged, steep plateaus made of volcanic glass with dramatic cliffs and glowing magma fissures.

name: Floating Arch Savanna
description: Dramatic landscapes dominated by massive natural stone arches suspended over deep valleys.

name: Starfall Crags
description: Precipitous mountain peaks riddled with glowing meteor craters and sheer drop-offs.

name: Aetherial Spirelands
description: Extreme, needle-like rock spires soaring into the clouds with suspended low-poly landmasses.
